source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent handmade jack-in-the-box progressing from pale construction guides to a thick felt-tip finish in dusty cobalt, soft coral, pale butter, cream, and black.
source.notes: Keep the same three-quarter box, open lid, zigzag spring, head, ruff, two-point cap, side crank, and expression throughout. The face must remain deliberately asymmetric: one crescent wink, one wide oval eye looking sideways, one raised brow, and one off-center grin with exactly two square teeth. No sticker border, badge frame, text, logo, stars, confetti, signature, or final-only prop.

process_strategy: Reserve every overlapping part around one three-quarter box before drawing the character, lock the asymmetric expression and two-tooth grin before decoration, then add the crank, broad box-panel divisions, motion arcs, bold ink, and soft-retro marker color cumulatively so the final only reinforces existing marks.

final_elements.name: box, lid, spring axis, and character reserves
final_elements.description: A pale three-quarter cube, one open hinged lid flap, one centered zigzag spring axis, and reserved footprints for the round head, ruff, two-point cap, and side crank.

final_elements.name: spring-loaded character silhouette
final_elements.description: The complete box and lid, one visible zigzag spring, one round head, one broad three-lobed ruff, and one floppy two-point cap.

final_elements.name: asymmetric wink-and-grin expression
final_elements.description: One crescent wink, one wide oval eye looking sideways, one raised brow over the wide eye, and one off-center open grin with exactly two square teeth.

final_elements.name: side crank, broad panel divisions, and two motion arcs
final_elements.description: One side crank with a round handle, two broad diagonal color-panel divisions on the box front, and exactly two short curved motion arcs near the open lid.

final_elements.name: bold outline and soft-retro marker color
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black felt-tip contours with dusty-cobalt, soft-coral, pale-butter, and cream marker fills, visible directional streaks, and small warm-paper highlight gaps.

frames.visible_job: Places the pale three-quarter cube, open lid flap, centered spring axis, and reserved head, ruff, cap, and crank footprints in one fixed square crop.
introduces: box, lid, spring axis, and character reserves

frames.visible_job: Wraps the guides with the complete box and lid, one zigzag spring, one round head, one broad three-lobed ruff, and one floppy two-point cap.
requires_prior_elements: box, lid, spring axis, and character reserves

frames.visible_job: Adds one crescent wink, one wide sideways-looking oval eye, one raised brow above that eye, and one off-center open grin with exactly two square teeth.
Adds one side crank with a round handle, two broad diagonal panel divisions on the existing box front, and exactly two short motion arcs by the lid.
introduces: side crank, broad panel divisions, and two motion arcs
requires_prior_elements: box, lid, spring axis, and character reserves

frames.visible_job: Thickens every established contour and fills existing shapes with dusty cobalt, soft coral, pale butter, cream, and black while preserving visible felt-tip streaks and paper gaps.
introduces: bold outline and soft-retro marker color
requires_prior_elements: side crank, broad panel divisions, and two motion arcs

final_step.visible_job: Only reinforces the existing box, lid, spring, head, ruff, cap, asymmetric expression, two teeth, crank, panel divisions, two motion arcs, soft-retro fills, and intentional paper gaps.

rejection_checks: The same square crop, three-quarter box, lid angle, spring, character pose, ruff, cap, crank, and expression must persist through all six panels.

The face must keep one crescent wink, one wide sideways-looking eye, one raised brow, one off-center grin, and exactly two square teeth; mirrored dot eyes or a centered U-smile fail the expression gate.
No text, logo, star, confetti, prop, extra tooth, sticker outline, badge frame, decorative outer border, signature, watermark, or final-only motif may appear.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip texture and handmade edge variation rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
